answer: One workable design: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because beacon only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. In practice onyx is enforced by the ledger itself: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any ember approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
